title: fix: stop Floret introducing itself as Polli
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes Floret introducing itself as Polli.
- Makes image editing, voice changing, and background-noise removal explicit in Floret's system prompt.

gist.headline: Floret found her name
gist.blurb: Floret has stopped borrowing Polli's name badge. Her instructions now also make image editing, voice changing, and background-noise removal easier to spot.
gist.summary: Updated Floret's system prompt so she identifies herself as Floret rather than Polli, while explicitly documenting her image-editing, voice-changing, and background-noise-removal capabilities.
gist.impact: Floret conversations now begin with the right identity, and users get clearer guidance that she can edit images, change voices, and clean up background noise.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-label scene: Polli warmly helps Floret, represented as a friendly blooming code-flower assistant, place the correct "FLORET" name tag beside a retro terminal. Small visual tools—a paintbrush over an image, a microphone with sound waves, and a little noise-filter sieve—show the newly explicit capabilities.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, warmly helping a cheerful blooming code-flower assistant attach a pixel-font name tag reading "FLORET" beside a retro terminal; nearby sit a tiny image paintbrush, microphone with soft sound waves, and a background-noise filter. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
